#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string x;
    cin >> n >> x;
    const char* ch = x.c_str();

    int max_len = 0;
    int countw = 0;
    int i = 0;

    while (i < n) {
        switch (ch[i]) {
            case '_':
                i++;
                break;
            case '(': {
                int open = i;
                int count = 0;
                i++;
                while (i < n && ch[i] != ')') {
                    if (ch[i] == '_') {
                        if (count > 0) {
                            countw++;
                            count = 0;
                        }
                    } else if (ch[i] != '(') {
                        count++;
                    }
                    i++;
                }
                if (i < n) {
                    if (count > 0) {
                        countw++;
                    }
                    i++;
                } else {
                    i = open + 1;
                }
                break;
            }
            default: {
                int count = 0;
                while (i < n && ch[i] != '_' && ch[i] != '(') {
                    count++;
                    i++;
                }
                max_len = max(max_len, count);
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << max_len << " " << countw << endl;
    return 0;
}
